Commit c060f943d092 (""mm: use aligned zone start for pfn_to_bitidx
calculation"") fixed out calculation of the index into the pageblock
bitmap when a !SPARSEMEM zome was not aligned to pageblock_nr_pages.

column2: the _allocation_ of that bitmap had never taken this alignment
so depending on the exact size and alignment of
the use of that index could then access past the allocation

column1: resulting in some very subtle memory corruption.
This was reported (and bisected) by Ingo Molnar: one of his random
config builds would hang with certain very specific kernel command line

column2: commit c060f943d092 has been marked for stable

column1: fix needs to be back-ported to the stable kernels that backported the
commit to use the right alignment.
